_meta.purpose: Pins every external dataset the build consumes. The scan-time binary never downloads anything (PLAN.md section 1), so this file is the sole provenance record for the bundled registry.
_meta.discipline: A hash mismatch is fatal, not a warning. Changing a pin is a deliberate act that must be accompanied by a DECISIONS.md entry.

alternate_pins._note: Supported fallbacks. The builder is version-agnostic (DECISIONS.md D-005); switching pin requires only editing attack_stix above and re-running fetch_stix.py.

build_toolchains._note: Recorded for reproducible-build purposes. Not consumed by the registry builder.

go.verified: both archives downloaded and SHA-256 verified against go.dev release metadata on 2026-10-14

python.role: build-time registry builder and offline report post-processing only

runtime_dependencies._note: Deliberately empty. The Go binary uses the standard library only, so there is no third-party runtime dependency to license or hash.
